summary: Each K=1 turn is ONE optimizer step from the current head on the turn miner's admitted groups. Everything a turn used is in /k1/turns/<epoch>/turn.json after the gate decision; this file is the fixed recipe.

model.head: the current head checkpoint (turn.json decision.head / training.input.checkpoint), bf16 weights
model.trainable: model.language_model.* and lm_head.* (vision tower and MTP heads frozen)

data.groups: the selected rows of the signed filtered dispatch, in dispatch order (turn.json dispatch.selected); each row = one task, 8 rollouts (nonces 0-7) from the miner document (turn.json documents), outcomes from the validator's native grades in the row
data.projection: subnet/mimo_grpo/projection.py project_document (prompt = native grade prompt tokens; output tokens = the uploaded tokens)
data.row_order: group order x nonce order; this order defines rows i = 0..N-1
data.miner_logprobs: ignored by the trainer (recomputed from the head)

loss.formula: L = loss_scale * (1/N) * sum_i (1/(K_i + 1e-8)) * sum_{t<=K_i} [ pg_{i,t} + kl_coefficient * k3_{i,t} ]
loss.N: active rollouts (all rollouts of the turn; unresolved ones stay in with reward 0)
loss.K_i: kept response tokens of rollout i (all tokens unless derail-masked)
loss.pg: vanilla dual-clip PPO (clip_ratio 0.2, dual_clip 3.0) with OLD = current.detach(): ratio 1, gradient -A_i * grad log pi
loss.k3: exp(ref - cur) - (ref - cur) - 1, ref - cur clamped to [-20, 20], k3 clamped to [-10, 10]; kl_coefficient 0.02
loss.advantage: A_i = r_i - mean(r of the 8 rollouts of its task), no std normalisation
loss.derail_mask: only rollouts stopped at max_tokens with A_i < 0: K_i cut at the first derail index (window 32, threshold -3.0, tail 64; subnet/mimo_grpo/training.py derail_keep)

execution.engine: packed varlen data parallel over 8 GPUs (v83_dp)
execution.microbatches: first-fit-decreasing over rows sorted by (-length, index), token budget 32768 per bin, max 256 rows; bins assigned to the least-loaded of 8 ranks in order of decreasing size (LPT); turn.json training.microbatch.rank_tokens
execution.forward: bf16; full-attention layers: torch varlen_attn (FlashAttention-2, causal, GQA); linear-attention layers: fla 0.6.0 causal_conv1d + chunk_gated_delta_rule (varlen, Triton); lm_head in bf16, logits/log-softmax in fp32 in chunks of 4096 tokens; layer activation checkpointing (numerically identical recompute)
execution.accumulation: per rank: fp32 buffer += bf16 param.grad after each micro-batch; ranks: fp32 dist.reduce SUM over NCCL to rank 0
execution.clip: global L2 norm over the fp32 sums, scale = min(1, 1.0 / (norm + 1e-6))

optimizer.name: fresh AdamW (one step from zero moments)
optimizer.delta: d_t = lr * (g_t / (|g_t| + 1e-8) + 0.01 * W_t * [W_t >= 2-D and not a bias])
optimizer.global_cap: s = min(1, 1.0 / ||r * d||) (not binding in practice)

fp32_master.rule: M_H = the head fp32 master; d_t and r_t are computed from M_H (not fp32(bf16 W)); M_C = M_H - fp32(s * r_t) * d_t; candidate bf16 = bf16_round_nearest_even(M_C); GREEN -> M_C becomes the head master; RED -> discarded
fp32_master.bootstrap: the first v8.3.3f turn (epoch 274) uses M_H = fp32(bf16 head) exactly
fp32_master.moments: not persisted (fresh zero state every turn, as before)
fp32_master.digest: sha256 of canonical JSON {tensor name: sha256(little-endian fp32 bytes)} (sorted keys, separators , :); bf16 digest: same over bf16 bytes
fp32_master.committed_in: turn.json training.optimizer.sgd.fp32_master (input/output master digest, input/output bf16 sha256, source bootstrap-upcast|memory|disk)
fp32_master.published: on every GREEN: R2 checkpoints/<C>/fp32-master/fp32-master-XXXXX-of-XXXXX.safetensors + meta.json; manifest https://affine.io/k1/fp32-master/<C>.json; index https://affine.io/k1/fp32-master/index.json
fp32_master.check: bf16_round_nearest_even(published master) == published bf16 head of <C>; master digest == turn.json output_master_digest

optimizer.update_v833f: W_new = bf16_round_nearest_even(M_C), M_C = M_H - fp32(s * r_t) * d_t (from epoch 274)

determinism.why: FlashAttention-2 / fla Triton backward kernels and the NCCL reduction order are not run-to-run deterministic; the forward (per-rollout losses) replays exactly, the gradient closely (pre-clip norm within about 0.5%), and the bf16 weights differ in a small fraction of elements by one step size. Measured: /k1/replay/results.json

grading_note.gate: gate probe grades use the live native grade plus Allan lenient rules (catoneone/sn120-k1-fixes 786cdb9) for non-positive EOS replies
grading_note.training: training rewards use the native grades in the signed dispatch rows (unchanged; miner and validator grader must match)
